headline: Field brief — Probe X1 outdoor range walk protocol
body: Two-kilometer park loop; log RSSI every 100m; abort if battery drops below 15% mid-run.
author: Elena Engineer

headline: Protocol — Probe X1 cold-start sequence after sleep
body: Wake from deep sleep, wait 8s for GNSS lock, then sample 30s continuous before recording pass/fail.
author: Elena Engineer

headline: Acceptance criteria — Probe X1 batch B-2026-01 ship gate
body: Zero critical open issues; mean session duration ≥45m; firmware 1.4.2 on every unit before ship.
author: Morgan Manager

headline: Field plan — Gateway G2 industrial site week
body: Mon–Wed indoor mesh soak; Thu vehicle loop; Fri debrief with site facilities and photo evidence pack.
author: Elena Engineer

headline: Decision — hold Gateway G2 outdoor rollout until mesh fix
body: No new outdoor sites until packet-loss ticket closes; existing outdoor units stay on 2.0.1 with daily checks.
author: Morgan Manager

headline: Field brief — Sensor S3 prototype north ridge pilot
body: Prototype only on ridge path; log temperature every 5m; capture wind noise clips if audio drops.
author: Elena Engineer

headline: Protocol — Sensor S3 firmware 1.1.0 flash and verify
body: Flash via dock, verify boot banner, run self-test suite, then seal serial SN-SN-004 with sticker.
author: Elena Engineer

headline: Acceptance criteria — Logger L1 recall exit checklist
body: All recalled units inventory-matched; repair cost ledger balanced; no active assignments remaining.
author: Morgan Manager

headline: Field plan — Logger L1 post-recall revalidation sample
body: Pull three repaired units; 48h indoor soak then 2h outdoor; escalate if any checksum mismatch.
author: Elena Engineer

headline: Protocol — Probe X1 vehicle vibration harness setup
body: Mount on passenger dash mount; cable strain relief at 15cm; log 20-minute city loop with GPS track.
author: Elena Engineer

headline: Decision — freeze Probe X1 protocol edits during pilot week
body: No protocol edits mid-pilot; file change requests on eng desk for Monday review after pilot close.
author: Morgan Manager

headline: Field brief — batch B-2026-03 mixed model soak notes
body: Cross-model soak for Probe, Gateway, and Logger; flag any cross-talk above -70dBm at 2m separation.
author: Elena Engineer
